fluff.overview: Most Lyran troops undergo some form of paratrooper training during their service, but the soldiers who actually deploy with the Lyran Paratrooper Corps are a cut above. Experienced, talented, and organized into three-squad platoons of twenty-one troopers, the Corps operates as a strategic asset rather than a tactical one. Armed with Mauser and Gray G-150 rifles and backed by heavy recoilless rifles, paratroopers like those attached to the Third Skye CMR can deploy at a moment's notice from the Commonwealth's extensive inventory of fixed-wing transport craft. Their ability to conduct atmospheric drops gives them access to battlefields that ground-bound formations simply cannot reach in time.
